# Alternative public packing donors

These are geometry-distinct alternative layouts retained from already public Kaggle files. They are not claimed as original discoveries. Every selected CSV remains bound to its exact SHA-256, and inherited mathematical discoverers and notebook authors retain their original credits.

Public notebook release evidence: research/ftmc_strategy.md records the official Kaggle viewer Apache-2.0 notice for public notebooks. This is a notebook release notice, not a blanket relicensing claim for every inherited packing. Dataset compilations retain their own terms and inherited notices. The complete KMMM frontier lineage is preserved in ../kmmmvs-v24/SOURCE_NOTICES.md; Dariush dataset credits and terms are in ../dariush-v11/DATASET_DESCRIPTION.md. The original Shubin baseline notice remains in vendor/SOURCES.md.

Identical-byte mirrors are recorded in the donor manifest. The versioned original dataset is preferred as the canonical provenance where an identical public notebook merely republishes it. No mirror notebook is assigned a dataset version number.

The local importer, selection, deduplication, lossless reconstruction recipes and independent validation are this project's work. Only centers receive conservative numerical clearance; every square retains unit side length. D4 and translation are used for duplicate detection; no arbitrary rotation, angle snapping, core stripping or wall-phase averaging is applied to retained layouts.
